modules.name: fc_int8_tile8
modules.responsibility: Own the job FSM, dimension checking, banked operand/bias storage, address generation, tile traversal, scalar bias/ReLU egress, and external protocol. Instantiate one mac_tile8x8. Operand/bias writes occur only on accepted input edges; memory reads are combinational with zero registered latency and never consumed concurrently with writes.

ports.name: clk
ports.semantics: Common rising-edge clock; connected directly to mac_tile8x8.clk.

ports.name: rst
ports.semantics: Active-high synchronous reset with handshake suppression; connected directly to mac_tile8x8.rst.

ports.name: cmd_valid
ports.semantics: Command valid; acceptance requires cmd_ready and !rst.

ports.name: cmd_ready
ports.semantics: IDLE && !rst; accepted legal command latches all three dimension fields.

ports.name: cmd_m
ports.semantics: M command field; reject values outside 1..MAX_M.

ports.name: cmd_n
ports.semantics: N command field; reject values outside 1..MAX_N.

ports.name: cmd_k
ports.semantics: K command field; reject values outside 1..MAX_K.

ports.name: in_valid
ports.semantics: Scalar operand valid; must remain asserted with stable data while stalled.

ports.name: in_ready
ports.semantics: High only in operand-loading phases and !rst.

ports.name: in_data
ports.semantics: Implicit A/B/bias frame: A and B use low eight bits with upper bits ignored; bias uses all bits. Accepted edge writes exactly one element.

ports.name: out_valid
ports.semantics: EMIT && !rst; payload is combinational from stable current-tile state.

ports.name: out_ready
ports.semantics: Advances output coordinate only with out_valid && !rst.

ports.name: out_data
ports.semantics: ReLU(wrap32(mac_tile8x8.sum+bias[current_column])) when out_valid, otherwise zero.

ports.name: out_last
ports.semantics: High only for the valid final output coordinate; stable throughout a stall.

ports.name: busy
ports.semantics: !rst && FSM!=IDLE.

ports.name: done
ports.semantics: One registered cycle after final output acceptance; zero on reset and otherwise cleared on the next edge.

ports.name: error
ports.semantics: One registered cycle after each invalid command acceptance; IDLE remains ready. Reset clears the event.

modules.name: mac_tile8x8
modules.responsibility: Implement the fixed 64-lane outer-product MAC register array and combinational indexed accumulator read. No internal FSM, start/done protocol, or memory latency is hidden.

ports.name: clk
ports.semantics: Same rising-edge clock as parent.

ports.name: rst
ports.semantics: When high at an edge, inhibit clear and step; accumulators need not reset. Combinational sum is forced to zero while high. Parent guarantees INIT before every use.

ports.name: clear
ports.semantics: Parent drives !rst && FSM==INIT. At that rising edge, set all 64 accumulators to zero. Priority over step; asserted exactly one cycle per tile.

ports.name: step
ports.semantics: Parent drives !rst && FSM==MAC. If clear=0, update all mask-enabled lanes on that edge. Parent asserts for exactly K successive edges per tile; no ready/done response.

ports.name: act_lanes
ports.semantics: Parent combinational bank reads pack A[8*tr+i,k] into bits [8*i+7:8*i] for i=0..7. Each slice is independently signed INT8. Invalid rows and cycles outside MAC drive zero; no input register latency.

ports.name: weight_lanes
ports.semantics: Parent combinational bank reads pack B[k,8*tc+j] into bits [8*j+7:8*j] for j=0..7. Each slice is independently signed INT8. Invalid columns and cycles outside MAC drive zero.

ports.name: row_mask
ports.semantics: Parent drives bit i=(i<R) in INIT/MAC/EMIT and zero otherwise. Lane (i,j) updates only when row_mask[i] && col_mask[j]. Masked lanes hold.

ports.name: col_mask
ports.semantics: Parent drives bit j=(j<C) in INIT/MAC/EMIT and zero otherwise. Masks remain fixed throughout a tile.

ports.name: read_row
ports.semantics: Parent drives current local EMIT row i, or zero outside EMIT.

ports.name: read_col
ports.semantics: Parent drives current local EMIT column j, or zero outside EMIT.

ports.name: sum
ports.semantics: Zero while rst is high; otherwise combinational acc[read_row][read_col], with no registered read latency. Reflects a MAC update immediately after its edge. Parent consumes only in EMIT and holds read indices under output stall. Contents before the first clear are unspecified and unobservable externally.
